snapshot.title: Refactor runtime object creation to scene files
snapshot.description: Move procedurally generated UI elements and game objects from .gd scripts to .tscn scene files. Scripts should only contain behavior/logic, not object instantiation. See @doc/dev/refactoring-plan for detailed analysis.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Identify all scripts creating UI/visual objects at runtime
Move static/reusable objects to scene files
Keep only procedural/dynamic generation in scripts

snapshot.implementationPlan:
1. Audit runtime UI/visual object creation hotspots (SidescrollMining, Structure, AsteroidPreview)
2. Move static/reusable nodes to scenes where still script-created
3. Keep procedural-only generation in scripts
4. Validate by running experience tests
5. Update notes/AC and close task
snapshot.implementationNotes: Created analysis doc @doc/dev/scene-vs-script-refactoring-guide. Key findings: SidescrollMining.gd creates 90+ visual objects at runtime (rocks, minerals, particles). Should use object pools or pre-placed nodes in scene. Structure.gd creates collision shapes at runtime. AsteroidPreview.gd creates debris procedurally. Documented refactoring patterns and priorities.
